general_notes: Pilot Dataset v2: Extended pilot covering the first 10 recipes from Section 22 (ချက်ပြုတ်နည်းများ), spanning printed pages 73-79 (PDF pages 42-45).

Updated unit specification per user feedback: In the 'unit' field, metric equivalents in grams (g) or pieces have been added alongside the original Burmese units (e.g., 'ကျပ်သား (g)', 'နို့ဆီဘူး (g)', 'စားပွဲဇွန်း (tbsp / g)', 'ခွက် (cup / g)').
Dry rice and lentils in traditional volumetric condensed milk tins (နို့ဆီဘူး) have been normalized at the standard Myanmar kitchen density of 250 g per tin.
Liquids in condensed milk tins, cups, and spoons have been standardized directly in grams (1 ml ≈ 1 g).
All 10 recipes have 100% 1:1 aligned Burmese Unicode and natural culinary English instruction steps.
All ingredient references resolve seamlessly to the deduplicated bilingual catalog (I0001 - I0039).
Batch 3 completed: Recipes R0011 - R0020 spanning printed pages 80-84 (PDF pages 46-48). Added 17 new catalog ingredients (I0040 - I0056).

Batch 4 completed: Recipes R0021 - R0042 (22 recipes) spanning printed pages 85-95 (PDF pages 48-53). Added 29 new catalog ingredients (I0057 - I0085). All duck, mutton, beef, and pork dishes validated.

Batch 5 completed: Recipes R0043 - R0067 (25 recipes) spanning printed pages 96-107 (PDF pages 54-59). Added 31 new catalog ingredients (I0086 - I0116). Covers Catfish, Steamed Hilsa, Featherback fish balls, Fried crab claws, Sweet-sour crab, Stuffed crab shells, Jellyfish salad, Prawn curries, Mango pickles, Lime pickle, Tamarind pickle, Cauliflower pickle, String bean pickle, Tomato sauce/ketchup, Guava jelly, Marmalade, and fruit chutneys.
